notes.title: FREE PROLOGUE IS COMING!
notes.content:
Mall Simulator 2025 – Free Prologue is coming tomorrow! (July 30th) Don't forget to add it to your wishlist to be notified when it comes out! ⬇️


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3502270/Mall_Simulator_2025_Prologue/"][/dynamiclink]

WHAT’S DIFFERENT FROM THE DEMO?
This trial version includes performance improvements plus 30 brand new STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS on top of the demo content!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45164805/244f21a1c739cf1628bb95d6f45a6cfbcd20f351.png"]

WHO SHOULD PLAY IT?
If you’ve played the demo before and want to try out new strategies, or if you want to collect exclusive Prologue achievements for your profile – or if you’ve never played the demo at all, this is the perfect starting point!
[hr][/hr]And of course, I know many of you are eagerly waiting for the Early Access main game version – Mall Simulator 2025 will officially launch after the Prologue, and I’ll be making a separate announcement for that! So stay tuned for this big release date! ❤️


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3180150/Mall_Simulator_2025/"][/dynamiclink]If you haven’t added the full game to your wishlist yet, now’s the time! ⬆️ I'm really excited about this!🔥

notes.title: DEMO RELEASE!
notes.content:
All right, everybody, I have an announcement. If you're ready, this Friday (April 11th) you will be able to play the Mall Simulator 2025 Demo for free!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3582710/Mall_Simulator_2025_Demo/

If you still haven't added it to your wishlist, make sure you do!

Let's shape the game, you and me! Join my Discord server to share all your excitement and feedback on Mall Simulator 2025! ❤️
